unitTitle: Choose a home and describe a neighbourhood
title: Phrases
subtitle: A2 · Unit 6: Choose a home and describe a neighbourhood

steps.title: Phrases
steps.body: In your notes, draw two columns for two homes. Compare price, location and one feature; then close the notes and recommend one option for a person with a specific need.

steps.title: Say the whole block
steps.body: Learn these as blocks, exactly as you hear them. Say each one out loud. Tap the speaker to hear it.

steps.fr: Le studio est moins cher que l'appartement d'une chambre.
steps.en: The studio is less expensive than the one-bedroom apartment.
steps.tip: Say it: luh stü-DYOH eh mwan shehr kuh lah-pahr-tuh-MAH(N) dü-n shah(n)-br

steps.fr: Le logement B est plus près de l'arrêt d'autobus.
steps.en: Home B is closer to the bus stop.
steps.tip: Say it: luh lohzh-MAH(N) bay eh plü preh duh lah-REH doh-toh-BÜS

steps.fr: Les deux logements sont aussi lumineux l'un que l'autre.
steps.en: The two homes are just as bright as each other.
steps.tip: Say it: lay duh lohzh-MAH(N) sohn oh-SEE lü-mee-NUH lu(n) kuh lohtr

steps.fr: Le quartier A est le plus paisible.
steps.en: Neighbourhood A is the most peaceful.
steps.tip: Say it: luh kahr-TYAY ah eh luh plü peh-zee-bl

steps.fr: Le logement B a plus d'espace de rangement que le studio.
steps.en: Home B has more storage space than the studio.
steps.tip: Say it: luh lohzh-MAH(N) bay ah plü deh-SPAHS duh rah(n)-zhuh-MAH(N) kuh luh stü-DYOH

steps.fr: Le loyer est moins élevé, mais le trajet est plus long.
steps.en: The rent is lower, but the trip is longer.
steps.tip: Say it: luh lwah-YAY eh mwan ay-luh-VAY meh luh trah-ZHAY eh plü lohn

steps.fr: Cet appartement offre le meilleur accès au train.
steps.en: This apartment offers the best access to the train.
steps.tip: Say it: seht ah-pahr-tuh-MAH(N) ofr luh meh-YUHR ahk-SEH oh tra(n)

steps.fr: Pour moi, le coût mensuel est le critère le plus important.
steps.en: For me, the monthly cost is the most important factor.
steps.tip: Say it: poor mwah luh koo mah(n)-sü-EHL eh luh kree-TEHR luh plü a(n)-por-TAH(N)
